changeSet.author: ogc-285

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.label_preset WHERE is_system = true

changeSet.comment: Seed 5 system label presets from the legacy per-type site_information label keys per FRS §2.7
changeSet.sql: WITH si AS ( SELECT name, value FROM clinlims.site_information WHERE name ~ '^(height|width|numDefault|numMax)(Order|Specimen|Block|Slide|Freezer)Labels$' ), normalized AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN value ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN value::INTEGER ELSE NULL END AS num, name FROM si ), legacy AS ( SELECT seed.legacy_type, seed.preset_name, (SELECT num FROM normalized WHERE name = 'height' || seed.legacy_type || 'Labels') AS height_mm, (SELECT num FROM normalized WHERE name = 'width' || seed.legacy_type || 'Labels') AS width_mm, (SELECT num FROM normalized WHERE name = 'numDefault' || seed.legacy_type || 'Labels') AS default_qty, (SELECT num FROM normalized WHERE name = 'numMax' || seed.legacy_type || 'Labels') AS max_qty FROM (VALUES ('Order', 'Order Label'), ('Specimen', 'Specimen Label'), ('Block', 'Block Label'), ('Slide', 'Slide Label'), ('Freezer', 'Freezer Label') ) AS seed(legacy_type, preset_name) ) INSERT INTO clinlims.label_preset (id, name, height_mm, width_mm, barcode_type, prints_per_order, prints_per_sample, default_per_order, max_per_order, default_per_sample, max_per_sample, is_system, is_active, last_updated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.label_preset_seq'), preset_name, LEAST(200, GREATEST(5, COALESCE(height_mm, 25))), LEAST(200, GREATEST(5, COALESCE(width_mm, 76))), 'CODE_128', (legacy_type = 'Order') AS prints_per_order, (legacy_type <> 'Order') AS prints_per_sample, CASE WHEN legacy_type = 'Order' THEN COALESCE(default_qty, 1) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN legacy_type = 'Order' THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(max_qty, 10), COALESCE(default_qty, 1)) ELSE 10 END, CASE WHEN legacy_type <> 'Order' THEN COALESCE(default_qty, 1) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN legacy_type <> 'Order' THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(max_qty, 10), COALESCE(default_qty, 1)) ELSE 10 END, true, true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM legacy;

DO $$ DECLARE problems TEXT; BEGIN WITH legacy AS ( SELECT substring(name from '(Order|Specimen|Block|Slide|Freezer)Labels$') AS legacy_type, substring(name from '^(height|width|numDefault|numMax)') AS field, value::INTEGER AS num FROM clinlims.site_information WHERE name ~ '^(height|width|numDefault|numMax)(Order|Specimen|Block|Slide|Freezer)Labels$' AND value ~ '^[0-9]+$' ), seeded AS ( SELECT CASE name WHEN 'Order Label' THEN 'Order' WHEN 'Specimen Label' THEN 'Specimen' WHEN 'Block Label' THEN 'Block' WHEN 'Slide Label' THEN 'Slide' WHEN 'Freezer Label' THEN 'Freezer' END AS legacy_type, height_mm, width_mm, CASE WHEN prints_per_order THEN default_per_order ELSE default_per_sample END AS default_qty, CASE WHEN prints_per_order THEN max_per_order ELSE max_per_sample END AS max_qty FROM clinlims.label_preset WHERE is_system = true ) SELECT string_agg(l.field || l.legacy_type || 'Labels=' || l.num, ', ') INTO problems FROM legacy l JOIN seeded s ON s.legacy_type = l.legacy_type WHERE (l.field = 'height' AND s.height_mm IS DISTINCT FROM LEAST(200, GREATEST(5, l.num))) OR (l.field = 'width' AND s.width_mm IS DISTINCT FROM LEAST(200, GREATEST(5, l.num))) OR (l.field = 'numDefault' AND s.default_qty IS DISTINCT FROM l.num) OR (l.field = 'numMax' AND s.max_qty < l.num); IF problems IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OGC-1219: system label presets were seeded from fallbacks although v1 barcode configuration exists (%)', problems; END IF; END $$;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.label_preset WHERE is_system = true;
